newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Players shares rise.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Players shares rise.

text.p: Shares of Players International Inc climbed after hours to trade at 8, up 3/8 from the close, traders said.
The company announced several management changes Monday, including the resignation of vice chairman and co-founder David Fishman and the expansion of the board of directors.
The stock had climbed 1-1/8 during market hours to close unofficially at 7-5/8.
Otherwise, traders said the after-hours volume was light.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 131,100 shares and session two volume was 515,600 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said it saw no after-hours volume.
